title: dnd-5e-2024 module stats (docs/rulesets.md#modules)
description: An arrangement (docs/content-model.md#arrangements) that contains encounters and other modules: kit parts in story order, its length, and the levels it's written for. A table part's table, the levels' order, and no module containing itself are checks in modules.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks).

parts.description: The kit parts, in the order the page renders them; its `arrangement` parts are the encounters and modules it contains, in story order.

length.description: How long it runs: a single session, a short dungeon, or several sessions.

levels.description: The party levels it's written for, authored, since nothing derives them. `min` is at most `max`, a check in modules.ts.

Part.description: One kit part, by its `part`. A module allows the shared text, sequence, table, and map parts, and its own hook and arrangement parts; rosters, spawn tables, and loot are its encounters'.
